title: WorkflowStep
description: A single processing step within a workflow. Steps are executed in sequence and each performs a specific data processing operation.

id.description: The unique identifier of the step

name.description: The display name of the step

type.description: The type of processing operation the step performs

position.description: The position of the step in the workflow sequence (0-based)

configuration.description: Type-specific configuration parameters for the step

enabled.description: Whether the step is enabled for execution
